For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

I was doing so well, just throwing everything as far as I could ( and I actually getting some enjoyment out of the crunching sound they made when they hit the ground ) when out of the corner of my eyes, I see my giant childhood teddy bear ( appropriately named `` Mr. Bear. '' )

output.disgust: I was just hurling everything as far as I could, finding some twisted enjoyment in the crunching noise, when, out of the corner of my eye, I spotted my giant childhood teddy bear, Mr. Bear, and it made me feel utterly repulsed.
